story_position: Chapter 1 cleanup window — optional Character-Life C03
scene_purpose: Give the newly formed Cyanis/Ilyra/Torren trio an ordinary, low-stakes camp dinner scene after the Chapter-1 climax. Let early friendship emerge through food, silence, mild irritation, and naturally arising humor rather than a chain of punchlines or explicit relationship commentary.

sections: Beat 15 — Wayfinder Camp / Chapter-1 Cleanup Window

scene_context_seed.runtime_note: Camp presentation allows Cyanis, Ilyra, and Torren to be physically present. Portraits and dialogue box carry performance. One fire/pot/bowls/bread are sufficient because dinner is the premise; no cooking montage or detailed food animation. This is early Cyanis/Torren friendship, so avoid later-story vicious-safe brother banter. Ilyra participates as an ordinary person, not caretaker or mediator. No lore, Hunt progression, gameplay reward, or relationship speech. Silence is valid material.

required_character_truths: Torren treats food as practical first: hot/enough/safe/cheap, with taste secondary.
Cyanis is socially playful and willing to waste time on a stupid argument when the situation is safe enough.
Ilyra can joke, laugh, and take a side or refuse one without becoming the scene's caretaker.
Cyanis and Torren are beginning to become comfortable, but their later brother-like insult language is not yet fully earned.
The scene must be able to end in comfortable silence without explaining that comfort.
